description: This Java source file defines the EntityCrypto class, which provides encryption and decryption functionalities for entity data within the OFBiz framework. It manages cryptographic keys, supports multiple storage handlers, and handles backward compatibility with legacy encryption methods.

classes.name: EntityCrypto
classes.description: Provides cryptographic operations for entity data, including key management, encryption, and decryption with support for multiple storage handlers and legacy methods.

classes.name: EntityCrypto.StorageHandler
classes.description: Abstract class defining methods for key generation, encoding/decoding, and value encryption/decryption.

classes.name: EntityCrypto.ShiroStorageHandler
classes.description: Implements StorageHandler using Apache Shiro's cryptography services with optional key encryption.

classes.name: EntityCrypto.LegacyStorageHandler
classes.description: Implements StorageHandler using DES encryption for legacy support.

classes.name: EntityCrypto.SaltedBase64StorageHandler
classes.description: Implements StorageHandler with salted Base64 encoding, supporting key encryption.

methods.name: EntityCrypto
methods.description: Constructor initializing the EntityCrypto with a delegator and optional key encryption key.

methods.name: encrypt
methods.description: Encrypts an object into a hex-encoded string using a specified key and encryption method.

methods.name: decrypt
methods.description: Decrypts a hex-encoded string into an object using a specified key and encryption method, with fallback for legacy decryption.

methods.name: doDecrypt
methods.description: Performs decryption with a specific storage handler.

methods.name: findKey
methods.description: Retrieves the cryptographic key associated with a given key name, loading from database if necessary.

methods.name: createKey
methods.description: Generates and stores a new cryptographic key for a given key name.
